text:
Conflict card:

Concrete input: eligible = true, fraud_hold = true, context = card.

Rule A - "Refund eligible purchases." triggers on this input and requires action: refund.
Rule B - "Route fraud-held purchases to manual review." triggers on this input and requires action: manual_review.

The required actions refund and manual_review are incompatible for this input.

Which rule wins for this case?
cost_basis: all terminal provider usage, persisted from first request
